completion.title: Completion Threshold
completion.description: Controls when a {{slide}} or chapter shows as completed (green tick) in the {{learner}} app. Progress percentages themselves are unaffected — this is the display cutoff.

thresholdField.label: Mark as complete at
thresholdField.help: Default 80%. Certificates use their own threshold under Certificate Settings.

reading.title: Reading & Documents
reading.description: How long a {{learner}} must actually spend on document content before it counts as viewed.

pageDwell.label: Minimum time per page
pageDwell.help: A PDF/document page flicked past faster than this does not count as viewed. Default 10s.

actionDwell.label: Minimum time per action
actionDwell.help: Applies to interactive slides (Jupyter, Scratch, Code editor). Default 5s.

readingTimeToggle.label: Content-aware reading time
readingTimeToggle.help: Long single-page documents require time proportional to their length before counting as read — a 3,000-word page is no longer "done" in 10 seconds. Recommended on.

minSeconds.label: Minimum
minSeconds.help: Floor for very short notes. Default 10s.

maxSeconds.label: Maximum
maxSeconds.help: Cap for very long pages. Default 600s (10 min).

focus.title: Focus & Idle Detection
focus.description: The "are you still there?" check and automatic pause that stop idle time from counting as study time on document slides. Video check-in frequency is configured under Display Settings → Concentration.

idlePopupToggle.label: Show attention check on inactivity
idlePopupToggle.help: When off, no popup is shown; tracking still auto-pauses after the hard pause below.

idleDelay.label: Show check after
idleDelay.help: No mouse/keyboard/touch activity for this long triggers the check. Default 60s.

hardPause.label: Hard pause after
hardPause.help: Tracking always pauses after this much inactivity, popup or not. Default 5 min.
